title: 第853章 算你倒霉碰到我第852章 他等太久了等的不想再等了
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 他对这青衣女狐有印象，印象还蛮深刻的，他记得，上古时代狐族在妖界的地位不算太高，可这狐妖表现出来的实力却压过了龙族白虎这些顶尖圣兽族群出来的天骄。
地下，她举刀砍下的力度，他都惊讶到了。
换做他，化神境界时都发挥不出这样的实力，那一刀已经超过了化神境界范畴，甚至一些中阶合体都可能差一点。
除了实力，他还在这青衣狐妖身上感觉到了一种能量，号召力。
炼神塔的钥匙原先是挂在炼神塔上的，可为了多获得一些能量，他调动栖灵宝境的法则之力炼了三个小的秘境，并和红色绒毛一样，实化了三种怪物在这三个秘境里，然后取下炼神塔的钥匙扔在了三种秘境里。
青衣狐妖进去了盾影鬼堡，眼见她们便要取得钥匙离开，他临时心生一计，将三大秘境融合在了一起。
妖族本就不是团结的族群，外加上靠吃妖升级的三种怪物，他想看看，这一次青衣狐妖她们还有什么办法脱困。
开始，青衣狐妖她们确实陷入困境，被慌张的群妖和不停杀戮的怪物堵的无地下脚，可很快，那青衣狐妖便冷静下来有了主意。
她拿出了她用来对付红色绒毛怪的神秘蓝色保护罩。
对这个蓝色保护罩，他不是不好奇的，虽然他的身体还没有完全成型，可各种器官已经开始运作，能挡住他胃液的腐蚀，这蓝色保护罩的品阶起码也是极品宝器。
甚至，更高。
宝器之上，可就是圣器了。
整个魔族也没几件圣器，要他如何相信一个不过圆满化神的小妖拥有圣器？
他没有纠结很久，宝器也好，圣器也罢，等这狐妖死了，全是他的。
这样的天骄，和平时代诞生不出来，只有当形势严峻到连岁月都觉得该有一个人出现改变现状，才会集时代之力培养出一个各方面都远超同龄人，且肩负使命之人。
他不禁去想，莫非他复活的这段岁月，三界局势又紧张了？
随即，兴奋取代所有情绪。
他实在太喜欢动荡的乱世了，有什么比一复活就可以大开杀戒更让人心情愉悦的呢？
他现身了，并不是因为那青衣狐妖的几句威胁，而是他觉得，这样的天骄够资格让他出来见她一面，够资格知道，她死在了谁的手里。
他吞了她，等同吞了一个时代的希望，他都不敢想，他的实力会增加到何等地步？
“真的是烛冥昪玦大人，我居然见到了烛冥昪玦大人？”
夺舍了妖族身体的魔族族人激动的喃喃自语，对修真界妖界来讲，烛冥昪玦大人或许是噩梦般的存在，可对他们魔族，烛冥昪玦大人绝对是高高在上的，神明般的人物。
圆满大乘的修为，第二魔族的族长，上古时代一出场便让三界为之震颤，哪怕烛冥昪玦大人是有些过于嗜血好杀，可在这些功绩面前便不算什么了。
昊云提到的那段过往历史，他们魔族也流传着一个版本，不过不是妖界修真界向烛冥昪玦大人约战，而是妖界和修真界被烛冥昪玦大人杀怕了，设下弥天大计害烛冥昪玦大人上当，意外惨死。
因为这件事，渊魔族恨妖界修真界从上古时代恨到现在，时时刻刻都想着重新开启大战，好为自己曾经的族长报仇。
“太好了，要是渊魔族知道大人您没死，定会兴奋的难以复加，魔主他们也会开心您能再次回来魔族。”
听到魔主两个字，烛冥昪玦情绪才有点波动，他想问魔族的近况，也想问问他死后魔主是何反应，但想了想，没必要，还是等他回去魔族自己去看去问吧。
他不是魂修，但他发现下方魔族族人附身妖族的方式很特别，不是夺舍，而是保留原身体的生命，想办法只将自己的一抹神识贴在原身体的灵魂上，借此操控身体行动。
这种控制方法，不仅方便，而且大大降低了暴露的风险，就算做了些引人怀疑的事，旁人也查探不出你真实的身份，因为不论是灵魂还是肉身你都没有去破坏。
这方法好啊，想出这样招式的人简直是天才。
他随口问了句，“是谁将你带到妖界的？”
这个问题不算难回答，只要说个人名就好，可下方魔族族人却犹犹豫豫，最后小心道，“回大人话，我，我不能说。”
content_en:
He was impressed by the female fox in green, and the impression was quite profound. He remembered that in ancient times, the status of the fox clan in the demon world was not very high, but the strength shown by this fox demon surpassed the geniuses from the top holy beast clans such as the dragon clan and white tiger.
Underground, he was surprised by the force with which she slashed with the knife.
If it were him, he wouldn't be able to exert such strength even in the realm of God Transformation. That sword had already exceeded the scope of the realm of God Transformation, and even some mid-level fusions might be a little bit worse.
In addition to strength, he also felt a kind of energy and appeal in this green-clothed fox demon.
The key to the God Refining Tower was originally hung on the God Refining Tower, but in order to gain more energy, he mobilized the power of the laws of the Soul-Living Treasure Realm to refine three small secret realms, and like the red fluff, materialized three kinds of monsters in these three secret realms, and then took off the keys to the God Refining Tower and threw them in the three secret realms.
The green-clothed fox demon entered the Shield Shadow Ghost Castle, and when he saw them about to get the key and leave, he came up with a temporary plan to merge the three secret realms together.
The demon tribe was not a united group to begin with, and with the addition of three types of monsters that relied on eating demons to upgrade, he wanted to see how the green-clothed fox demons and the others could get out of trouble this time.
At first, the green-clothed fox demon and the others were indeed in trouble, blocked by the panicked group of demons and the killing monsters. But soon, the green-clothed fox demon calmed down and came up with an idea.
She pulled out the mysterious blue protective shield she used against the red fluff monster.
He was not uncurious about this blue protective shield. Although his body was not fully formed yet, various organs had already begun to function and could block the corrosion of his gastric juices. The grade of this blue protective shield was at least a top-notch treasure.
Even higher.
Above the treasures, there are holy weapons.
The entire demon clan didn't have many holy weapons. How could he believe that a little demon who had only fully transformed into a god possessed a holy weapon?
He didn't hesitate for a long time. Whether it was a treasure or a holy weapon, when the fox demon died, it would all be his.
Such a genius cannot be born in peaceful times. Only when the situation is so severe that even the years feel that someone should appear to change the status quo, will the power of the times be gathered to cultivate a person who is far superior to his peers in all aspects and has a mission.
He couldn't help but wonder, could it be that during the years when he was resurrected, the situation in the Three Realms had become tense again?
Immediately, excitement replaced all emotions.
He really liked the turbulent and chaotic world. What could be more pleasurable than being able to go on a killing spree as soon as he was resurrected?
He showed up, not because of a few threats from the green-robed fox demon, but because he felt that such a talented person was qualified enough for him to come out to see her, and qualified enough to know in whose hands she died.
If he swallowed her, it would be like swallowing the hope of an era. He didn't dare to imagine how far his strength would increase.
"It's really Lord Zhu Mingminjue, and I actually met Lord Zhuming Minjue?"
The demon clan members who had taken away the demon clan's body murmured excitedly to themselves. To the demon world of cultivation, Lord Zhu Ming Minjue may be a nightmare-like existence, but to their demon clan, Lord Zhu Ming Minjue is definitely a towering, god-like figure.
With perfect Mahayana cultivation, he is the leader of the second demon clan. He made the three worlds tremble when he appeared in ancient times. Even though Master Zhu Ming Mingjue is a little too bloodthirsty and easy to kill, it is nothing in front of these achievements.
The demon clan also circulated a version of the past history mentioned by Hao Yun. However, it was not that the demon world and the cultivator world asked Lord Zhu Ming Minjue to fight, but that the demon world and the cultivator world were afraid of being killed by Lord Zhu Ming Minjue.
Because of this incident, the Abyss Demon Clan has hated the Demon Realm and the Cultivation Realm from ancient times until now, and they always want to restart the war in order to avenge their former clan leader.
"That's great. If the Abyss Demon Clan knows that you are not dead, sir, they will be extremely excited. The Demon Lord and the others will also be happy that you can come back to the Demon Clan again."
Hearing the word "Demon Lord", Zhu Ming Minjue's mood fluctuated a little. He wanted to ask about the current situation of the Demon Clan, and also wanted to ask about the Demon Lord's reaction after his death, but after thinking about it, it was not necessary. It was better to wait until he returned to the Demon Clan to go and ask on his own.
He is not a soul cultivator, but he found that the way the demon clan below possesses the demon clan is very special. It is not to seize the body, but to retain the life of the original body, and find a way to attach only a touch of his consciousness to the soul of the original body to control the body's actions.
This control method is not only convenient, but also greatly reduces the risk of exposure. Even if you do something that arouses suspicion, others will not be able to find out your true identity, because you have not destroyed either your soul or your body.
This method is great, the person who came up with such a move is simply a genius.
He asked casually, "Who brought you to the demon world?"
This question is not difficult to answer, as long as you say your name, but the demon clan below hesitated, and finally said carefully, "Speak to me, sir, I, I can't say."
title_en: Chapter 853 You are unlucky to meet me Chapter 852 He has been waiting for too long and doesn’t want to wait any longer.
